title: Relative skeletal filtration for split functors
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a cocomplete category, with all categories, Hom sets and colimits in containing universes. Use simplicial sets, standard simplices and boundaries of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and colimits of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $T:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathrm{sSet},\mathcal C)$ be a simplicial diagram of functors preserving all small colimits. Suppose given colimit-preserving functors $N_q:\mathrm{sSet}\to\mathcal C$ and natural transformations $N_q\to T_q$ such that, for every $p$, the canonical degeneracy map
$$\coprod_{[p]\twoheadrightarrow[q]}N_q\longrightarrow T_p$$
is an isomorphism of functors; its component indexed by a surjection $\sigma$ is $N_q\to T_q\xrightarrow{T(\sigma)}T_p$. The identity surjection is included. Define
$$R_T(K)=\int^{[p]\in\Delta}T_p(K\times\Delta^p),$$
as the coequalizer of the two maps from $\coprod_{\alpha:[a]\to[b]}T_b(K\times\Delta^a)$ to $\coprod_pT_p(K\times\Delta^p)$ induced by $T(\alpha)$ and $\Delta^\alpha$ respectively. For every map $i:K\to L$ of simplicial sets, $R_T(i)$ admits a countable filtration $Z_{-1}=R_T(K)\to Z_0\to Z_1\to\cdots$ with colimit $R_T(L)$, whose $p$th transition is a pushout of
$$N_p\big((L\times\partial\Delta^p)\amalg_{K\times\partial\Delta^p}(K\times\Delta^p)\big)\longrightarrow N_p(L\times\Delta^p).$$
The attaching map is induced by the face operators and the coend maps. The filtration is natural in $i$ and in maps respecting the specified splittings. It includes $p=0$ and empty $K,L$. No model structure or enrichment of $\mathcal C$ is assumed.
